warnings.detail: 海上：臺灣附近各海面及巴士海峽航行作業船隻應嚴加戒備。陸上：臺灣各地區、澎湖及馬祖應嚴加戒備，並防強風豪雨。

comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風：中央氣象署已發布薔琵颱風陸上颱風警報，10/23 14 時至 10/24 08 時規則燈為中。不過機場觀測平均風僅 9.5 節、側風 7.7 節，八個模式全判低，陣風超過 49 節的機率 0%。10/27–10/28 美國 AI 模式估算陣風達 38.6 節，但未獲多數模式支持。官方警報生效中，判為中。

comment.en: The main cause is strong wind: the Central Weather Administration has issued a land typhoon warning for Typhoon Bang-pi, and the rule light is Medium from 10/23 14:00 to 10/24 08:00. However, airport observations show a mean wind of only 9.5 kt and a crosswind of 7.7 kt, all eight models say Low, and there is a 0% chance of gusts over 49 kt. On 10/27–10/28 the US AI model shows an estimated gust of 38.6 kt, but most models do not support it. With the official warning in effect, the rating is Medium.

comment.en: The main factor is strong wind/crosswind, but the overall disruption risk is rated Low. Although a land typhoon warning for Typhoon Champi sets the official level to Medium from 10/23 14:00 to 10/24 08:00, the airport observation (METAR) shows a mean wind of only 9.5 kt, and the models agree on Low (25% chance of gusts over 29 kt and a peak estimated gust of 30.1 kt from the Japanese model during 10/23 14:00–20:00). From 10/27 14:00 to 10/28 02:00, only the US AI model shows estimated gusts of 38.6 kt, while all other models say Low.
